walkthrough_npdrm.purpose: the only fully observed end-to-end CCP/keymgr transaction: claim -> submit x2 -> release
steps: 0x64E226 call 0x62C570            # keymgr claim; u16 slot lands in [rbp-0x70]
0x64E34D..0x64E355 movzx edi,ax; call 0x62C610   # release by id (edi = slot)
walkthrough_npdrm.release_note: the release is skipped when the slot value is 0 (0x64E34D test ax,ax / je)

binding.call: rdi = pointer to a u16 out slot; returns 0 on success, error code in eax

operations.semantics: dequeue-free-slot round robin over a 64-record TAILQ; tag := 0xFFFFFFFF; count 0->1; pool occupancy counter ++; the id is a u16 out

binding.call: edi = slot id (u16); returns 0 on success, 0xFFFFFFFE when the id is not found

operations.semantics: count decrement; on count 1->0 the occupancy counter -- and a channel wake unless the slot's skip flag is set; INV_SLOT_001 (a released slot must not be usable) is an agent assertion, not a kernel refusal

binding.call: bind entry (tag = key handle); candidate route for the framework test key

operations.semantics: existing-tag path: rotate + count++ only; fresh path: cache-tree lookup of the key handle, then bind (tag write, count++, skip-flag, occupancy ++, sm storage calls)
open: the exact primitive that stores NEW key material into a slot is not proven; candidates are the sm storage helper 0x630230 with the {0x101/0x102, handle} request and a 0xC1000-family submit message
framework test key only: the provider must never touch a protected slot (REQ-CCP section 2 C)
operations.mark: [B] for the bind path; [O] for the store primitive

binding.call: rdi = request envelope (first qword = message); returns int

operations.semantics: builds the wrapper-side callback/context, maps the caller's engine field into message+0xA0 and invokes the engine's virtual submit; blocking variant
pool telemetry: lock/name pointers, sm gate, occupancy counter, 64 slot records (id/count/tag/flags/links)
operations.mark: [B] for the layout, [O] for the live values

fields.flags: +0x0C u32 (bit0 = skip: not dequeueable, wake suppressed)

slot_semantics.capture_state: idle: all counts 0, all tags 0xFFFFFFFF, occupancy 0, list rotated (head = record 0xBE)
invariants: INV_SLOT_001: after keymgr.release the slot must not be usable again until a new claim (agent-side assertion; the kernel itself reports rc=0 for a release of an already-released record)
INV_CCP_002: after a failed submit N the state for N+1 is treated as new (experiment assertion)
